name: 용아기 보육실
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, stone nursery chamber with a low glowing brazier warming a nest of speckled dragon eggs at the center, cracked eggshell fragments and soft moss scattered nearby, curved brick walls lined with small alcoves, warm amber firelight pushing against cool teal moonlight from a narrow slit window, three-quarter interior view with generous open floor in front, gentle rising heat haze, richly detailed fantasy concept art.
